segments.ja511:1.3: Kiṃ patthayāno kiṃ esaṃ, kena atthena brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja511:4.3: Satthena naṃ vikappetvā, khuppipāsaṃ ahāsi me.
segments.ja511:5.1: Sohaṃ apetadaratho, byantībhūto [byantibhūto (sī. pī. ka.)] dukhakkhamo;
segments.ja511:6.1: Sosetvā nūna maraṇaṃ, taṃ mamaṃ āvahissati;
segments.ja511:6.3: Ambaṃ yassa phalaṃ sādu, madhuraggaṃ manoramaṃ;
segments.ja511:7.1: Akkhātaṃ te mayā sabbaṃ, yasmā upavasāmahaṃ;
segments.ja511:8.1: Tvañca kho meva [me (sī.), mama (?)] akkhāhi, attānamapalāyini;
segments.ja511:8.3: Kā vā tvamasi kalyāṇi, kissa vā tvaṃ sumajjhime.
segments.ja511:9.3: Yā santi nāriyo devesu, devānaṃ paricārikā.
segments.ja511:10.3: Rūpena te sadisī natthi, devesu gandhabbamanussaloke [devagandhabbamānuse (syā.)];
segments.ja511:10.5: Puṭṭhāsi me cārupubbaṅgi, brūhi nāmañca bandhave.
segments.ja511:11.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ pati nisinnosi, rammaṃ brāhmaṇa kosikiṃ;
segments.ja511:14.1: Tā ambajambulabujā, nīpā tālā cudumbarā [tālamudumbarā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja511:15.1: Yaṃ kiñci ubhato tīre, phalaṃ patati ambuni;
segments.ja511:15.3: Asaṃsayaṃ taṃ sotassa, phalaṃ hoti vasānugaṃ.
segments.ja511:17.1: Na vāhaṃ vaḍḍhavaṃ [vaddhavaṃ (sī. pī.)] maññe, yaṃ tvaṃ raṭṭhābhivaḍḍhana;
segments.ja511:18.1: Tassa jānanti pitaro, gandhabbā ca sadevakā;
segments.ja511:18.3: Ye cāpi isayo loke, saññatattā tapassino;
segments.ja511:18.5: Asaṃsayaṃ tepi [te (sī. pī.)] jānanti, paṭṭhabhūtā [vaddhabhūtā (sī. pī.)] yasassino.
segments.ja511:19.1: Evaṃ viditvā vidū sabbadhammaṃ, viddhaṃsanaṃ cavanaṃ jīvitassa;
segments.ja511:19.3: Na cīyatī tassa narassa pāpaṃ, sace na ceteti vadhāya tassa.
segments.ja511:20.1: Isipūgasamaññāte, evaṃ lokyā viditā sati [pati (ka. syā. ka.)];
segments.ja511:21.1: Sace ahaṃ marissāmi, tīre te puthusussoṇi;
segments.ja511:21.3: Asaṃsayaṃ taṃ asiloko, mayi pete āgamissati.
segments.ja511:22.1: Tasmā hi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, rakkhasseva [rakkhassu ca (syā.)] sumajjhime;
segments.ja511:22.3: Mā taṃ sabbo jano pacchā, pakuṭṭhāyi [pakatthāsi (sī. pī.), patvakkhāsi (syā.)] mayi mate.
segments.ja511:23.1: Aññātametaṃ avisayhasāhi, attānamambañca dadāmi te taṃ;
segments.ja511:23.3: So duccaje kāmaguṇe pahāya, santiñca dhammañca adhiṭṭhitosi.
segments.ja511:24.1: Yo hitvā pubbasaññogaṃ, pacchā saṃyojane ṭhito;
segments.ja511:25.1: Ehi taṃ pāpayissāmi, kāmaṃ appossuko bhava;
segments.ja511:27.1: Ambettha vippasākhaggā [vippasūnaggā (sī. syā. pī.), vippaonaggā (ka.)], palālakhalasannibhā;
segments.ja511:28.3: Rattiṃ tvaṃ paricāresi, divā vedesi vedanaṃ.
segments.ja511:31.1: Ajjhenāni paṭiggayha, kāmesu gadhito [gathito (sī. pī.), giddhito (syā. ka.), giddhiko (ka. aṭṭha.)] ahaṃ;
segments.ja511:32.1: Yo piṭṭhimaṃsiko hoti, evaṃ ukkacca khādati;
